Name: Heel of Achilles
Description: Cutting an enemy's Achilles tendon makes them fall - like Achilles (heel) and Krishna (sole of the foot), felled by one precise strike at their only weak point. Work in progress: heel cut knocks NPCs down for good and they bleed out; crawl pose with the game's own injured animations, upper-body swings from the ground, screams.
Author: Nadi
